metadata.question: Does the surface water extent increase in the area between the Elkhorn and Platte Rivers near Omaha in March 16, 2019 compared to March 2018?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy:
   - Dataset: Sentinel-1 GRD (SAR, cloud independent), mode IW, dual-pol when available.
   - Location: Polygon covering the Elkhorn–Platte confluence west of Omaha, NE.
   - Time:
     • 2019 target: centered on March 16 with fallbacks: [2019-03-14, 2019-03-18] → [2019-03-10, 2019-03-22] → [2019-03-01, 2019-03-31].
     • 2018 baseline: [2018-03-01, 2018-03-31], fallback widened if needed.
2. Masking strategy:
   - SAR: no cloud mask needed.
   - Convert VV to dB; water mask = VV_dB < -17.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error:
   - If ImageCollection size == 0 after fallbacks → C1.
   - If valid area (masked by VV) == 0 → C2.
   - If any reduceRegion returns null/NaN or values out of plausible bounds → C3.
   - Compare water area (km²). If 2019 > 2018 by at least max(1% of AOI area, 0.5 km²) → A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const aoi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [-96.3895, 41.1400],
    [-96.1530, 41.1400],
    [-96.1530, 40.9550],
    [-96.3895, 40.9550],
    [-96.3895, 41.1400]
  ]);

  const periods2019 = [
    ['2019-03-14', '2019-03-18'],
    ['2019-03-10', '2019-03-22'],
    ['2019-03-01', '2019-03-31']
  ];
  const periods2018 = [
    ['2018-03-01', '2018-03-31'],
    ['2018-02-20', '2018-04-10']
  ];

  function toDB(img) { return ee.Image(10).multiply(img.log10()); }

  async function getWaterStats(periods, label) {
    let chosen = null;
    let size = 0;
    let lastCol = null;
    for (const p of periods) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD')
        .filterBounds(aoi)
        .filterDate(p[0], p[1])
        .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW'))
        .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV'))
        .filter(ee.Filter.eq('orbitProperties_pass', 'ASCENDING').or(ee.Filter.eq('orbitProperties_pass', 'DESCENDING'))); // no-op just forces property presence
      size = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (size > 0) { chosen = p; lastCol = col; break; }
    }
    if (!chosen || size === 0) {
      console.log(`${label} Images: 0`);
      return { status: 'C1' };
    }
    console.log(`${label} Period: ${chosen[0]} to ${chosen[1]}`);
    console.log(`${label} S1 Images: ${size}`);

    const vv_db = toDB(lastCol.select('VV').median());
    const validMask = vv_db.mask();
    const waterMask = vv_db.lt(-17).updateMask(validMask);

    const areaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea();

    const validArea = await areaImg.updateMask(validMask)
      .reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: aoi,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e13,
        bestEffort: true
      }).get('area').getInfo();

    const waterArea = await areaImg.updateMask(waterMask)
      .reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: aoi,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e13,
        bestEffort: true
      }).get('area').getInfo();

    // Additional validation via coarse pixel counts
    const validCount = await vv_db.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e13,
      bestEffort: true
    }).get('VV').getInfo();

    const waterCount = await waterMask.rename('w').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e13,
      bestEffort: true
    }).get('w').getInfo();

    if (validArea === null || waterArea === null || isNaN(validArea) || isNaN(waterArea)) {
      console.log(`${label} Calculation failed (null).`);
      return { status: 'C3' };
    }
    if (validArea <= 0 || !isFinite(validArea)) {
      console.log(`${label} No valid pixels after masking.`);
      return { status: 'C2' };
    }
    const waterPct = 100 * (waterArea / validArea);
    const waterKm2 = waterArea / 1e6;
    const validKm2 = validArea / 1e6;

    console.log(`${label} Valid km²: ${validKm2.toFixed(2)}, Water km²: ${waterKm2.toFixed(2)}, Water %: ${waterPct.toFixed(2)} (px: ${validCount||0}/${waterCount||0})`);

    return {
      status: 'OK',
      period: chosen,
      validArea,
      waterArea,
      validKm2,
      waterKm2,
      waterPct
    };
  }

  try {
    const aoiArea = await ee.Image.pixelArea().reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e13,
      bestEffort: true
    }).get('area').getInfo();
    const aoiKm2 = aoiArea ? (aoiArea / 1e6) : null;
    console.log(`AOI km²: ${aoiKm2 !== null ? aoiKm2.toFixed(2) : 'NA'}`);

    const stats2019 = await getWaterStats(periods2019, '2019');
    if (stats2019.status !== 'OK') { console.log(stats2019.status); return; }

    const stats2018 = await getWaterStats(periods2018, '2018');
    if (stats2018.status !== 'OK') { console.log(stats2018.status); return; }

    // Sanity checks
    const plausibleMax = aoiArea * 1.05;
    if (stats2019.waterArea < 0 || stats2018.waterArea < 0 ||
        stats2019.waterArea > plausibleMax || stats2018.waterArea > plausibleMax) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const diffKm2 = stats2019.waterKm2 - stats2018.waterKm2;
    const threshold = Math.max(0.5, 0.01 * aoiKm2); // at least 0.5 km2 or 1% of AOI
    console.log(`Change km² (2019-2018): ${diffKm2.toFixed(2)} (threshold: ${threshold.toFixed(2)})`);

    if (diffKm2 > threshold) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
